radial_coordinate.note: this is exactly the information unit-normalisation destroyed. F2-raw = (PC1, PC2) = (rho cos phi, rho sin phi) carries angle AND radius; FA carries angle only. That is why exp68 on this family is width-as-INFORMATION, not width-as-reparameterisation.

committed_diagnostic_crosscheck.frozen_angle_space: the committed `frozen_angle` is EXACTLY exp42_noun_embeddings.json's stored angle -- the RUNTIME angle -- not atan2 of the normalised coordinates. Verified to 0.0 on all 24 nouns.

normalisation_forensics.finding: the committed producer's p1/p2 differ from instrument_sb_bounds.load_raw's by a CONSTANT per-component scale of 1 + 5.58e-08 (PC1) and 1 - 1.43e-08 (PC2)
normalisation_forensics.cause: it used the SIX-DECIMAL-ROUNDED divisors printed in instrument_sb_bounds' provenance string (8.669495, 10.160404) instead of the exact ones (8.669494516224397, 10.160404144924657). Re-applying that rounding reproduces the committed p1/p2 to 1.1e-16.
normalisation_forensics.consequence_for_exp70: exp70 uses the EXACT divisors, imported from instrument_sb_bounds and never re-typed. Under the exact divisors the committed eps-map concurrences shift by at most 4.37e-08 and the registered-map ones by at most 1.69e-07 -- seven orders of magnitude below the 0.10 degenerate-entanglement gate and below every digit the committed diagnostic's finding is stated to. The committed finding stands unchanged.

e_across_purity.median_convention_note: the committed median equals the UPPER middle element of the 276 distinct-pair values (sorted[len//2]), not numpy's interpolated median (0.9827363208). Every element matches to <1e-12; the only difference is the median convention, so the closed form 1 - (sin tA sin tB)^2/2 reproduces the committed distribution exactly.
e_across_purity.pair_set: 276 distinct unordered pairs of the 24 human nouns

E_in.per_referent_feature: (a^2, b^2, c^2, ab, ac, bc) -- outer square of the three coefficients
E_in.relation_to_the_product_register: NEITHER NESTED. The two half-angle terms leave the product span; `sin t1` alone is absent from the E-in span. The intersection is 4-dimensional (ranks 6, 9, 11 for E-in, P-eps and their union). The map is RESTRUCTURED, not enlarged, and nothing about which reaches further follows from dimension counting.
E_in.completeness: COMPLETE. The six coordinates are derived in closed form and the claimed 6-function basis is certified to span exactly the same space.

E_across.state: ( cA cB, cA sB, sA cB, -sA sB ), cX = cos(tX/2), sX = sin(tX/2)
E_across.joint_feature: the 10 independent entries of the outer square of that 4-vector
E_across.clifford_argument: CZ is Clifford, so conjugation permutes the Pauli coordinates; with a general readout the reachable function space is INVARIANT. The E-across span is exactly the 9-dimensional product span, identical to EA-ctrl's, with <X(x)X> identically zero and <Y(x)Y> = sin tA sin tB carrying what <X(x)X> carried in the control.
consequences: the N-across grade-1 bound EQUALS EA-ctrl's, by proof

FOURIER CLOSURE IS A NULL INSTRUMENT for N-across: closure in the product basis holds with the CZ present and absent alike, so validity must be asserted by the purity closed form and a circuit-difference check instead
the joint-state comparator for N-across is the SAME function class as EA-ctrl's, so it cannot separate them either: any measured difference is trainability / inductive bias, never capacity
E_across.completeness: COMPLETE, and verified: the Pauli closed-form table is checked against the statevector to better than 1e-12 on a 441-point grid.

e_across_over_the_80_SB_casts.closed_form: purity = 1 - (sin tA sin tB)^2 / 2, both wires
e_across_over_the_80_SB_casts.honest_note: many pairs are NEAR-PRODUCT. Over the full 24-noun inventory the committed diagnostic reports per-pair purity 0.5764-0.9999 with median 0.983, i.e. the median cast is only weakly entangled. E-across is a MECHANISM PROBE and this is the honest measure of how much mechanism it actually injects.
